metadata.title: Main Bhi Bharat । पंडो आदिवासियों का करमा नाच | Karma dance of the Pando PVTG tribe । Local Archery
metadata.description:
The Main Bhi Bharat team is currently in Chhattisgarh, collecting stories and creating ground reports for you, our viewer. Today, we reached an adivasi village near Ambikapur in Surguja district, where we met the Pando tribe, and we took part in their festivities. What you see here is a glimpse of the Karma dance that is performed as part of the rituals while praying to the Karam devta or the God of Fate. 

The Pandos are a PVTG tribe. Pando men and women are expert archers, as you can see in the video.

#pando #archery #chhattisgarh
